title: Export
brief: Window export UI: Postman v2.1 (collection, folder, request, environment; include secrets or not), ReqFlux bundle (workspace or collection/folder/request; secrets omitted or encrypted with a passphrase) and API docs (collection, README.md and index.html into a folder), from the tree, workspace and environment menus and the command palette, through the OS save and folder dialogs.

artboards.title: One export dialog
artboards.tradeoff: One menu item and one dialog with a format switch; every export costs a dialog step, even Postman without secrets

artboards.title: One item per format
artboards.tradeoff: Fewer steps (Postman and docs go straight to the OS dialog); four new items crowd the tree menu, and bolt has no submenu to fold them
